tables.name: Environment
tables.description: Certain environments suit certain resources (coastal for fishing, underground for mining), though nothing is restricted.

results.name: Coastal
results.description: The village is near a large body of water, such as a lake or ocean.

results.name: Forest
results.description: The village is nestled among the trees.

results.name: Mountains
results.description: The village is found on stony passes or soaring peaks.

results.name: Plains
results.description: The village is in the wide open fields.

results.name: River
results.description: The village is near a steadily flowing stream, or other watercourse.

results.name: Swamp
results.description: The village is in, or near, a vast area of stagnant water.

results.name: Underground
results.description: The village is within a large network of caves.

results.name: Valley
results.description: The village is found within, or on the edge of, an area of recessed elevation in relation to the landscape around it.

results.name: Tundra
results.description: The village is in a very cold environment.

results.name: Desert
results.description: The village is in a dry and arid environment, likely covered with vast sand dunes.
